document_validation.procedure_python3:
"""One-time W00 document review checks; not the application's validator or tests."""
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path

repo, kit, master = map(Path, sys.argv[1:4])
base = '96b8bd7590de0ca662d725b7fa0d708e811d6722'
allowed = {
    'CURRENT_STATE.md', 'docs/decisions/ADR-001-prototype-profile.md',
    'docs/reviews/work/W00_SCOPE_AND_CONTRACT.md', 'docs/reviews/work/W00_EVIDENCE.json',
    'docs/prototype/SOURCE_ALIGNMENT.md', 'docs/prototype/TASK_BOARD.md',
    'tracking/tasks.json', 'tracking/acceptance.json', 'handoffs/work/W00-96b8bd7.md',
}
results = []
def check(name, condition):
    if not condition:
        raise AssertionError(name)
    results.append({'assertion': name, 'result': 'PASS'})
def git(*args):
    return subprocess.check_output(['git', *args], cwd=repo, text=True).strip()
def read(path):
    return json.loads(path.read_text())

check('Exact inspected base', git('rev-parse', 'HEAD') == base)
check('Exact requested remote', git('remote', 'get-url', 'origin') == 'https://github.com/Nakum-hub/Cyberfyx-ORVIA.git')
check('Source reference byte identity', hashlib.sha256(master.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == '527daa1d6a2a7564a61d0375e540ca66b1bc8f33f4e71d327b0f6cb0bf6dbef6')
tracked = git('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', base).splitlines()
check('Base contains exactly seven documented files', set(tracked) == {'AGENTS.md','README.md','README_START_HERE.md','docs/prototype/ACCEPTANCE.md','docs/prototype/CONTRACT.md','docs/prototype/EXECUTION_PLAN.md','docs/prototype/FILE_OWNERSHIP.md'})
check('Existing files unchanged and six governing files match approved kit', all((repo/p).read_bytes() == (kit/p).read_bytes() for p in tracked if p != 'README.md') and not git('diff', '--name-only', base, '--', *tracked))
check('Repository source absence stated accurately', not (repo/'docs/source/ORVIA_Version_1_Unified_Master_with_Version_2_AI_Roadmap.md').exists())

current = read(repo/'tracking/tasks.json'); original = read(kit/'tracking/tasks.json')
tests = read(repo/'tracking/acceptance.json')['tests']
tasks = current['tasks']; task_ids = {t['id'] for t in tasks}; test_ids = {t['id'] for t in tests}
check('Task schema keys/version preserved', set(current) == set(original) and current['schema_version'] == original['schema_version'] == 1 and all(set(a)==set(b) for a,b in zip(tasks,original['tasks'])))
check('23 task IDs and order preserved', len(tasks) == len(task_ids) == 23 and [t['id'] for t in tasks] == [t['id'] for t in original['tasks']])
check('Task definitions, owners and dependency edges preserved', all(all(a[k] == b[k] for k in b if k not in {'status','planned_paths','evidence'}) for a,b in zip(tasks,original['tasks'])) and tasks[1:] == original['tasks'][1:])
check('Repository inspected; W00 blocked; no accepted commits', current['repository_status']=='INSPECTED' and tasks[0]['status']=='BLOCKED' and all(t['status']=='NOT_STARTED' for t in tasks[1:]) and all(t['commit'] is None for t in tasks))
check('W00 evidence paths exist', all((repo/p).is_file() for p in tasks[0]['evidence']))
check('Acceptance definitions and bytes unchanged', (repo/'tracking/acceptance.json').read_bytes() == (kit/'tracking/acceptance.json').read_bytes())
check('34 unique acceptance IDs, 30 P0 and 4 P1, all NOT_RUN without results', len(tests)==len(test_ids)==34 and sum(t['priority']=='P0' for t in tests)==30 and sum(t['priority']=='P1' for t in tests)==4 and all(t['status']=='NOT_RUN' and not t['evidence'] for t in tests))
graph = {t['id']:set(t['start_dependencies']+t['acceptance_dependencies']) for t in tasks}
check('Dependency/test references valid', all(v<=task_ids and k not in v for k,v in graph.items()) and all(set(t['test_ids'])<=test_ids for t in tasks) and all(set(t['implementation_tasks'])<=task_ids for t in tests))
visited, active = set(), set()
def visit(node):
    if node in active:
        raise AssertionError('Dependency cycle '+node)
    if node in visited:
        return
    active.add(node)
    for dep in graph[node]:
        visit(dep)
    active.remove(node); visited.add(node)
for node in graph:
    visit(node)
check('Combined start/acceptance graph acyclic', len(visited)==23)
board=(repo/'docs/prototype/TASK_BOARD.md').read_text()
expected=[]
for t in tasks:
    vals=[t['id'],t['owner'],t['priority'],t['status'],t['title'],', '.join(t['start_dependencies']) or 'Immediately',', '.join(t['acceptance_dependencies']) or 'Own evidence',', '.join(t['test_ids']) or 'Review deliverable']
    expected.append('| '+' | '.join(vals)+' |')
actual=[line for line in board.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\| [WABC]\d{2} \|',line)]
check('Generated task table matches every canonical task', actual==expected)
check('All four Work stages visibly tracked with intended deliverables', all(f'## {x} ' in board for x in ['W00','W01','W02','W03']))
acceptance=(repo/'docs/prototype/ACCEPTANCE.md').read_text()
check('Existing acceptance view matches all 34 canonical rows', [line for line in acceptance.splitlines() if re.match(r'^\| T\d{2} \|',line)] == ['| '+' | '.join([t['id'],t['priority'],t['title'],t['expected'],t['status']])+' |' for t in tests])
changed=set(git('diff','--name-only',base).splitlines()) | set(git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines())
check('Exactly nine Work-owned additions; no implementation paths', changed==allowed and all((repo/p).is_file() for p in allowed))
secret=re.compile(r'gh[pousr]_[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}|github_pat_[A-Za-z0-9_]{30,}|AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}|-----BEGIN (?:RSA |EC |OPENSSH )?PRIVATE KEY-----')
check('No common credential/private-key patterns in publish set (limited scan)', all(not secret.search((repo/p).read_text()) for p in allowed))
missing=[]
for p in allowed:
    if p.endswith('.md'):
        for target in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)',(repo/p).read_text()):
            if not target.startswith(('https://','http://','#')) and not ((repo/p).parent/target.split('#')[0]).exists():
                missing.append((p,target))
check('Authored Markdown links resolve', not missing)
manifest=read(repo/'docs/reviews/work/W00_EVIDENCE.json')
check('Evidence identifies actual inspected base and no executed application', manifest['code_under_test_commit']==base and manifest['application_results']['status']=='NOT_RUN')
print(json.dumps({'result':'PASS','assertion_count':len(results),'assertions':results,'application_tests':'NOT_RUN','publish_paths':sorted(allowed)},indent=2))
